subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests

question: After refreshing against current main, should this PR or the adjacent file-consent PR own the shared transfer-timeout policy?
rationale: Both open PRs appear to modify the same owner and share a transfer-budget contract, but their current merge results could not be directly compared.

options.title: Consolidate shared policy
options.body: Choose one PR to own the shared resolver, then retarget the other to its distinct call sites and tests.

options.title: Land sequentially
options.body: Merge one branch first and require a fresh review of the second branch's resulting diff and delivery semantics.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Hold both PRs until an MS Teams area owner chooses the permanent timeout contract and merge sequence.

recommendation.title: Consolidate shared policy
